title: Fix a Makefile that skips its tests and misses changes
instruction:
The Makefile has bugs. Fix it so that:
- make test builds dist/app.txt and then runs test/check.py. Today it prints that test is up to date and does nothing.
- dist/app.txt is the concatenation of every file matching src/*.txt in alphabetical order, and make dist/app.txt rebuilds it whenever any file in src/ changes or a new file is added there.
- make clean removes the dist directory.

Do not edit test/check.py.
